test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 'Bhotiya' is a caste of scheduled tribes of which of the following states in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bhotiya, tribe people are native (indigenous) people belonging to **Himalayan Belt**. 
 
• In Nepal they live in the northern and eastern regions of Nepal, where they and other Tibetans are the region's autochthonous (indigenous) people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bhil is the largest tribal group in India as per 2011 Census. They constitute approximately 38% of the total scheduled tribal population of India.
 
• **Bhil tribes** are found in the states of Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, as well as in Tripura.
 
• A major tribal groups of Madhya Pradesh consist of **Gond, Bhil, Baiga, Korku, Bhariya, Halba, Kol, Mariya and Sahariya**.
 
• Among them, **Baiga, Bhariya and Sahariya** are notified as Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) .
